messages:
Maya R: Hey — last-minute keeper trade idea: I'll give up my keeper spot #2 this season if someone takes Julio + my stadium ticket for Saturday. Finals are tomorrow and I have a wedding so can't stay for OT. Thoughts? :grimacing:
Chris L: Wait which Julio? Julio Jones? lol — you're trading a keeper for a ticket?
Liam: Nooooo. Keeper spots are gold. What's your backup keeper? Roster impact?
Maya R: Julio (RBJulio42) — banged up but maybe playable. Backup keeper would be Marcus T. Ticket is lower bowl but I'd rather not waste it.
Nina P: Oof marriage > fantasy — 100%. I'd take the ticket but not the keeper. Anyone want the keeper-only deal?
Samira: I might take Julio + ticket for my bench WR + $20? How much is the transfer fee anyway? :thinking_face:
Maya R: Fee looks like $5 on the app. I'll toss $20 on top to sweeten. Also low-key request: if you take the ticket, please bring a tiny fake trophy for the office shelf so I can keep bragging rights.
Chris L: I can cover the keeper if someone covers $30 and promises to spray-paint the office plant gold (kidding but also not). :sweat_smile:
league-bot: Waiver deadline in 2 hours. Submit offers here: https://fantasy.example/league/waivers (automated)
Liam: Quick poll — who wants the ticket? React with :ticket: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. Also snack vote: :pretzel: or :hotdog:?
Nina P: :ticket: :pretzel: counting me in for a pretzel and the mini-trophy craft duty.
Samira: :no_entry_sign: I'll take the keeper for $25 + I'll make the glitter trophy. DM me, Maya.
Maya R: Deal to Samira if Chris doesn't outbid $25 in DMs. I'll drop Julio in the trade chat once confirmed.
Chris L: Matching $25 for the keeper. @Samira you're on notice :eyes:
Liam: FYI stadium enforces no backpacks and a strict bag check. If you're taking the ticket, bring a fanny pack or expect a line. Learned the hard way last month.
Nina P: Also who wants to claim the halftime nacho run? I will do it if someone covers my parking. :parking: :nachos:
Samira: DM sent to Maya with offer details. If league accepts, i'll cover $25 and hand-deliver the glitter trophy next week. :trophy:
Maya R: Confirmed receipt of DM. Thanks y'all — if this goes through i'll owe someone a wedding + fantasy recap.
Chris L: If the trade clears, I want photographic evidence of the glitter trophy on the office shelf. Mandatory. :camera_with_flash:
